title: Dream of Jesse matching the Nas tweet reply

tellings.quote: And while I'm asleep, I have a dream about you coming to my house to get proolone

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, speaking to the podcast host Jesse Michels, says that while asleep at his home on the US East Coast he dreamed of Michels coming to his house to get provolone cheese. Borland links the dream to a later reply to a social media post that seemed to match it, which, as he tells it, suggests the dream foretold something.
